questions.stem: A mother brings her 8-year-old boy with complaints of joint pain and backache. The mother reports a history of hypermobility and frequent dislocations of his shoulders and knees. She also mentions the family history of heart problems in her Husband. Upon further examination, a lens dislocation is identified. A diagnosis of a Fibrillin protein defect was identified. What is the most common cardiac condition that can be seen in this boy?
